title: MEIKO — Teach Us, Ms. Shiho!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hnng! Okay, that's enough drumming for now! Time for a break.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hm? This sounds like... Is someone else practicing?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If so, I might go have a quick peek while I take my break...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello. I heard someone playing, so I decided to come take a look. Is it just you two here...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Ichi and Hona both had family business to take care of. So, Shiho and I decided to have our own practice session...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were actually just about to take a break. Would you like to join us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, if you don't mind me intruding.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We even brought snacks, so let's have some together! Gimme one second...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! It's back! New Year's brunch potato chips♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what...? Again with the weird flavors...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, Shiho, you don't get it. These were so good that the fans of these potato chips demanded they bring them back, and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I get it. You can give us this speech some other time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! But I was just getting to the best part!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Since I brought them, I'll see if Rin and the others also wanna try. Do you happen to know where they are right now, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin was practicing how to spin tops with Len on the rooftop the last I saw.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Tops?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember all those toys we picked out together for New Year's during that sale?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We tried playing with them soon after, and everyone got so excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah. We did struggle to get them to spin at first...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But KAITO's become really good.
So good that he's teaching the others now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, this sort of thing does seem to be right up KAITO's alley.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, since he's kinda like a craftsman!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what you mean.
His tops seem to always stay upright, and he won the tournament we held with ease.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, Rin and Len are practicing all they can in order to beat KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, you guys had a tournament?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That sounds so fun!
I wanna do a top-spinning tournament!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, Saki, we'll invite you and the others next time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! The more the merrier, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, we've been able to have so much fun because you two helped pick out those toys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, thank you both very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, like we said before, it's the least we could do since you've all done so much for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You even helped us pick out presents for Tsukasa and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, what happened after that? Did they like what you got them?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Tsukasa was sooo happy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since I got him a water bottle, I put a bunch of waterproof star stickers on it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The day I gave it to him, he carried it around with him all day while saying, “Its design is fit for a future star such as myself, and it shall never leave my side!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's even been placing it right next to his pillow when he goes to sleep!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can definitely see him doing that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. It certainly sounds like he's been enjoying what you got him!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, so... I received a similar reaction.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku especially liked how it had a fluffy tail. She kept touching it because she thought it felt so nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I had to stop her when she said she'd wear it every day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. That sounds like Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad they both enjoyed your presents so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, beside those, I'm sure they appreciate the thought you put into them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The thought we put into them...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I was only able to play a small role helping pick out your presents for them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you both thought long and hard about what to get them, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why I believe they both got your message. They know that you wish them both happiness and success in their endeavors.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I sure hope so...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now then... Let's go see Rin and the others. I'm curious to get a taste of these potato chips!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! I need them to try these!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm sure they're gonna love them!
So much that they're gonna forget all about practicing with their tops!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm looking forward to seeing what they think.
